parse_yearprob_config_string: parse a semicolon-delimited year-probability config string into a dictionary mapping years to probabilities
get_prob_of_latest_year_leq: get the probability for the greatest year less than or equal to a specified year from a year-probability dict
parse_year_spring_prob_of_ending: parse a config string into a year-probability dict representing the probability of ending a Diplomacy game at spring of each year
review_yearprob_parsing: review the yearprob module functions for parsing year-probability configuration strings and querying probabilities by year
summarize_yearprob_module: summarize the yearprob utility module that parses year-probability config strings and provides probability lookup by year
